Implemented the stateful `Editor` wrapper.

## Changes
- **`crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/editor.rs`** (new, 296 lines)
  - `Editor { state: EditorState, version: u64 }`
  - `EditorOptions { history_limits: Option<(usize, usize)> }`
  - `AppliedInfo { version, changes, selection, history }` — no document snapshot
  - Constructors: `new`, `with_options`, `from_doc`, `from_json` (all use `Schema::full()`)
  - `doc`, `selection`, `set_selection`, `version`, `transaction`, `history_info`, `clear_history`
  - `apply` → `Result<AppliedInfo, ApplyError>` via `EditorState::apply_owned`; version bumps only when the document snapshot changes (so selection-only transactions do not bump)
  - `undo`/`redo` → `Result<Option<AppliedInfo>, ApplyError>`; successful history moves bump version
  - `replace_document(Doc)` through `Transaction::replace_document` (`ReplaceDoc`)
  - `replace_fragment(Range, Fragment)`: splices top-level blocks on boundaries, builds a new `Doc`, and routes it through `replace_document` (`ReplaceDoc`); an empty range inserts at that boundary. Non-boundary/inverted ranges return typed `StepError`s.
  - Panic-free, no `unwrap`/`expect`.
- **`crates/rich-editor-auy/src/state/mod.rs`**: added `mod editor;` and re-exported `AppliedInfo`, `Editor`, `EditorOptions`.
- **`crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/editor.rs`** (new, 203 lines): 8 tests covering version increments/selection-only no-bump, undo/redo, selection get/set and bounds rejection, replace document + fragment + undo, fragment insertion and boundary rejection, history limits/clear, and `from_json`.

## Verification
- `cargo test -p rich-editor-auy --locked` — **green**; all suites pass, including the 8 new editor tests.
- `cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy --test editor -- -D warnings` — **green**.
- `rustfmt --check` on all touched files — **green**.
- Full `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` is currently red only in peer-owned files (`tests/step_attrs.rs:31` type complexity; `tests/step_mark_attrs.rs:12` type complexity, `:58` excessive nesting). I reported the exact locations to `StepExtensions`; no files outside my scope were modified.

body:
Confirmed after your fixes:

- `cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` → exit 0, no warnings.
- `cargo test -p rich-editor-auy --locked` → all 23 suites green, 0 failures.
- `rustfmt --check` on my files → clean.

The `Editor` wrapper deliverable is complete: `state/editor.rs` (Editor, EditorOptions, AppliedInfo, document/fragment replacement via `ReplaceDoc`, versioned apply/undo/redo, selection and history APIs), exports in `state/mod.rs`, and `tests/editor.rs` with 8 passing tests. No lib changes were needed in response to your round.
